game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the lava scout must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling cooling flasks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read a rectangle's width and height. Calculate its area and display the result. Test dataset 6: {'width': 7, 'height': 8}; {'width': 9, 'height': 2}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Sorter' (Week 2 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Crater Lake Edge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Protect the smelter from lava imps in Crater Lake Edge: keep the sorted_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: sorted_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Type Sorter – Crater Lake Edge Defense
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
